description: Traffic Signals and Pedestrian Signals is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This data contains information about traffic and pedestrian signals in the city of Austin, Texas. The data is updated on a daily basis and maintained by the Austin Transportation & Public Works Arterial Management Division. You may also be interested in the following resources: Traffic Signal Monitor Signal Evaluations. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are safety, traffic signals, transit, transportation, atms. The table has 56 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
